subject: math
description: Convert between square centimeters and square meters and explain why area conversion uses squared units.
learningObjectives: Identify when a measurement is an area measurement
Explain why area units are squared
Convert square meters to square centimeters
Convert square centimeters to square meters
Use area unit conversion in real measurement situations
prerequisites: Understand that area measures surface space
Multiply and divide by powers of 10
Read square units such as cm² and m²
